verdicts.reason: The two resizes are nearly identical. Both crop the blue photo into a thin, unreadable strip at the top, and in both 'Baby Toddler' runs into the right-hand dot pattern. A also leaves a dead gap between the photo and the ampersand, while 'BEDDING' sits low near the bottom edge, apart from the ampersand group. B pulls 'BEDDING' up so it forms a tighter group with the ampersand, which gives better grouping and an even bottom margin.
